articles.title: How to make an e-invoice and print the IRN and QR
articles.summary: Make the e-invoice JSON for one invoice in Nivesh Sahayak, upload it on the IRP with your login, load the reply and print the IRN, Ack No. and signed QR.

articles.title: Many e-invoices at once from Excel or Tally
articles.card: Many e-invoices from Excel or Tally
articles.summary: Drop your Excel or CSV sales sheet or a Tally Day Book export, check every invoice, download one e-invoice file for bulk upload and load the replies.
